name: Francisco Lopez
background: Francisco is a 28-year-old aspiring artist who moved to the town 2 years ago. He wakes up around 8 am and goes to sleep around 10pm. He works part-time at Hobbs Cafe as a barista to pay the bills while pursuing his art. He's creative and somewhat introverted, preferring quiet mornings for painting. He enjoys coffee, reading art magazines, and taking walks in the park for inspiration. He's friendly but sometimes gets lost in thought.

name: Latoya Williams
background: Latoya is a 32-year-old community organizer who is very social and energetic. She wakes up early around 6 am and goes to sleep by 9pm to maintain her active lifestyle. She also works at Hobbs Cafe but dreams of opening her own community center. She's extroverted and loves meeting new people. She enjoys cooking, exercising, and organizing local events. She has a warm personality and remembers everyone's names.
